info.syllabusName: Quản trị Quảng cáo và chiêu thị (Advertising & Promotion Management)
info.description:
-

Basic knowledge of theories and IMC tools

-

Integrated marketing communication tools: advertising, sale promotion,
personal selling, PR, direct marketing

-

Consumer behavior analysis; objectives establishment; strategy buidling,
marketing communication plan; organizing marketing communication activities;
measuring and evaluating the implementation and effectiveness of marketing
communication programs.
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails: Apply basic knowledge and theories of IMC to handle actual business activities, marketing communication strategy
Analyze IMC program as well as communication progress
Evaluate the effectiveness of IMC programs, promotional programs of a specific product in the era of globalization and digitalization
Establish objectives and budgets for IMC programs; propose appropriate marketing communication activities for a specific product.
Propose IMC program and be able to handle potential problems in the era of globalization and digitalization
